messages:
raul: Quick sync — we need new region-level widgets in Console: per-region p50/p95/p99, failover delta, and traffic split %. Who's owning metrics?

hannah: I can take runtime inputs. Need to know exact metric names and labels we'll standardize on. Are we adding a 'region' label to every request?

sana: Product wants per-route breakdown too (by route and model_version). Also show canary rollout windows and percentage overlays.

kai: runtime currently emits labels: region, zone, route, model_version. Sampling for traces/latency is 1% global — too sparse for low-traffic regions.

raul: Ok — we should do adaptive sampling per-region. Proposal: target ~200 latency samples/minute per region to get stable p95. Thoughts?

hannah: That works. I'll add a dynamic sampler. Proposed config snippet:```yaml
sampler:
  default_rate: 0.01
  region_targets:
    us-east-1: 200\/min
    eu-west-1: 200\/min
    ap-southeast-1: 100\/min
```

hannah: Also will emit a gauge 'routing_version' and a label 'failover_id' when we flip weights.

sana: Product wants a derived metric for failover impact: p95_post_failover - p95_pre_failover shown as 'failover_impact_ms'. Can we compute that?

kai: We can compute with PromQL on Grafana if we annotate the failover timestamp. Example query skeleton:```promql
(p95_over_time(region_latency_bucket{region=\"us-east-1\"}, 5m) - p95_over_time(region_latency_bucket{region=\"us-east-1\"}, 30m))
```
Not exact but shows idea. Need consistent windows and failover marker.

deploy-bot: deploy: region routing change applied for us-east-1 -> us-east-2 weights at 2026-03-10T15:21:09Z (id=ff21). :rocket:

hannah: Perfect — runtime will tag metrics with failover_id=ff21 and emit event to /events. We'll also start exporting kv_cache_miss_rate per region and route.

mira: For quotas: make sure traffic_split_fraction includes a 'customer_tier' label (hosted|dedicated|private). If not, dedicated customers will skew split percentages at org-level.

raul: Good call. We'll require customer_tier label on traffic metrics and on request_count.

sana: UX asks: dashboard must show annotations for rollout windows, canary percent slider, and allow filtering for a single route or model. Also add a low-traffic warning when region samples < threshold.

kai: One storage concern: high-cardinality labels (route+model_version+region) will blow up series. Suggest we write high-cardinality raw series to remote_write with TTL=7d and maintain aggregated timeseries for dashboards: region_latency_p95_ms{region,route?}.

hannah: Ok implementing an aggregation job that computes region p95 and writes region_latency_p95_ms with labels region and route (route optional). We'll also include customer_tier.

raul: Action items:
- hannah: implement dynamic sampler, emit routing_version and failover_id, export kv_cache_miss_rate (due Tue)
- kai: build aggregation job + remote_write TTL config and PromQL templates (due Wed)
- mira: validate quota metrics and customer_tier label across services (due Wed)
- sana: prototype dashboard wireframe + annotation UX (due Thu)

raul: Revisit sync on Thursday 11am PT — will need a short demo of prometheus queries and a mock dashboard.

sana: Thursday 11am PT works for me. I'll post mockup in #product before then. :eyes:

mira: I'll run a quick check against Dedicated customers to ensure labels are present and send a failing test if not.

hannah: Quick note — keep metric names snake_case and prefix with 'redwood_' or 'region_' as appropriate. I'll send exact metric list in a follow-up.

raul: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers ping me or @sana. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
